4. Provision selection and application: YES. Solver correctly identified sibling relationship matches 152(d)(2)(B) not (A); no conditions were treated as met without supporting facts.
5. Tool-assisted computation: NA. Task requires no arithmetic; only entailment determination based on relationship definitions.
